items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to providing for the construction of capital facilities for Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc. doing business as Broad Channel Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps, a not-for-profit corporation
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S8060

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the public authorities law, in relation to providing for the
construction of capital facilities for Broad
Channel Volunteers, Inc. doing business as
Broad Channel
Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps, a not-for-profit
corporation

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:
This legislation amends a chapter of
the laws of 2010 that will authorize the Dormitory Authority of the
State of New York ("DASNY") to provide construction related services
to the Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc., doing business as Broad
Channel Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:
Section 1. Paragraph (b) of subdivision 2 of section 1676 of the
public authorities law as added by a chapter of the laws of 2010 is
amended to read as follows:

Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc. doing business as Broad Channel
Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps for the purpose of
providing construction related services in connection with the
construction, reconstruction, improvement, renovation, development or
expansion of facilities owned by Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc.,
doing business as Broad Channel Volunteer Fire Department and
Ambulance Corps, located at 305 Crossbay Boulevard, County of Queens,
block 15304, lot 450, New York, 11693.

Section 2. Subdivision 1 of section 1680 of the public authorities law
as added by a chapter of the laws of 2010 is amended to read as
follows:

Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc. doing business as Broad Channel
Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps for the purpose of
providing construction related services in connection with the
construction, reconstruction, improvement, renovation, development or
expansion of facilities owned by Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc.,
conducting business under the assumed name of Broad Channel Volunteer
Fire Department and Ambulance Corps, located at 305 Crossbay
Boulevard, County of Queens, block 15304, lot 450, New York, 11693.

JUSTIFICATION:

This chapter amendment is necessary to identify the appropriate name
of the organization filed with the Department of State as the Broad
Channel Volunteers, Inc. Previous legislation (S.7140/A.10260)
referred to the name under which it was conducting business - Broad

Channel Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps. This
amendment identifies the organization name set forth in their
Certificate of Incorporation papers as the appropriate entity for the
Dormitory Authority to provide construction services, that is, Broad
Channel Volunteers, Inc.
doing business as Broad Channel Volunteer Fire Department and
Ambulance Corps. In addition, this legislation identifies the address
of the physical property owned by the Broad Channel Volunteers Inc.
where the construction of the facility will occur.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New Bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
The bill shall take effect on the
same date as the
legislation proposed in S.7140 and A.10260 takes effect.

summary: Enacts a chapter amendment relating to providing for the construction of capital facilities for Broad Channel Volunteers, Inc. conducting business under the assumed name of Broad Channel Volunteer Fire Department and Ambulance Corps, a not-for-profit corporation.
